shattered_gauntlet.title: Garrick's Shattered Gauntlet
shattered_gauntlet.name: Garrick's Shattered Gauntlet
shattered_gauntlet.subtitle: The Bulwark's Vow
shattered_gauntlet.memory_text: When the treeline collapsed, Shield-Brother Garrick shoved you behind him and took the crushing blow meant for your heart.
shattered_gauntlet.lore: The heavy iron fingers are still locked in a guard stance. Engraved inside the wrist-plate are the words Garrick shouted over the roar of the ambush: 'Run, kid. Tell the Watch we held the line.' He never left the gate.
shattered_gauntlet.primary: When the treeline collapsed, Shield-Brother Garrick shoved you behind him and took the crushing blow meant for your heart.
combat_taunts: Hold the line! Do not let the dark through!
shattered_gauntlet.death_line: You stood your ground, little brother...

corruption_variants.low: The cold iron warms in your palm, as if Garrick's steady hand still steadies your guard.
corruption_variants.mid: Black veins creep across the steel, warring with the Star-Fire engraving.
corruption_variants.high: The gauntlet's jagged plates bite into your wrist, fusing with Andras's shadow.

herbalists_satchel.title: Lyra's Field Satchel
herbalists_satchel.name: Lyra's Field Satchel
herbalists_satchel.subtitle: The Healer's Mercy
herbalists_satchel.memory_text: Medic Lyra bound your wounds under a hail of ash, whispering prayers to Candora until the shadows dragged her into the roots.
herbalists_satchel.lore: Dried silver-leaf and bloodstained linen remain inside. Even in the rot of the Elderwood, the satchel carries the faint scent of winter mint and a healer's stubborn refusal to let her company die.

corruption_variants.low: The silver-leaf still glows with a faint, comforting warmth.
corruption_variants.mid: The herbs crumble to grey ash between your fingers.
corruption_variants.high: Only thorns and dried blood remain where medicine once rested.

tainted_sigil.title: Tainted Star-Fire Crest
tainted_sigil.name: Tainted Star-Fire Crest
tainted_sigil.subtitle: The Iron Toll
tainted_sigil.memory_text: Garrick's silver Watch badge, twisted into the cloven sigil of Andras the night he begged for the strength to keep standing.
tainted_sigil.lore: He did not take the pact out of greed. Bleeding out beside the obsidian arch, Garrick swore his soul to Andras on one condition: that nothing would pass the gate to harm the survivors behind him. Andras kept the bargain - by turning Garrick into the gate's eternal monster.

corruption_variants.low: Beneath the demonic soot, the silver star of your old company still catches the moonlight.
corruption_variants.mid: The badge pulses in rhythm with the brand burning on your own palm.
corruption_variants.high: The Star-Fire crest is gone; only Andras's eye stares back from the metal.

voragis_inkwell.title: Orin's Brass Inkwell
voragis_inkwell.name: Orin's Brass Inkwell
voragis_inkwell.subtitle: The Scribe's Witness
voragis_inkwell.memory_text: Company Scribe Orin swore to record every fallen name so their families would know where they rested.
voragis_inkwell.lore: The brass is dented by a blade strike, and the ink inside has turned to liquid shadow. Orin kept writing even after his fingers turned to bone.

corruption_variants.low: The ink smells faintly of cedar and old parchment.
corruption_variants.mid: The dark fluid swirls on its own when you bring it near your chest.
corruption_variants.high: It whispers the names of the dead in Andras's voice.

vial_of_void_blood.title: Vane's Cinder Phial
vial_of_void_blood.name: Vane's Cinder Phial
vial_of_void_blood.subtitle: The Scout's Thirst
vial_of_void_blood.memory_text: Corporal Vane always shared his flask around the watchfire, laughing loudest when the nights grew freezing.
vial_of_void_blood.lore: When the vanguard was cut off from supply lines, Vane drank the crimson sap of the Elderwood to stay awake on triple-watch. Hour by hour, the sap replaced his blood until he could no longer recognize the friends he was guarding.

corruption_variants.low: You remember Vane's crooked grin by the campfire, before the forest hollowed him.
corruption_variants.mid: The crimson liquid pulls toward your veins like a tide.
corruption_variants.high: Your throat burns with the same unholy thirst that consumed Vane.

hollowed_ledger_page.title: Muster Roll of the Fourth Vanguard
hollowed_ledger_page.name: Muster Roll of the Fourth Vanguard
hollowed_ledger_page.subtitle: The Hollowed Company
hollowed_ledger_page.memory_text: A bloodstained page torn from the Watch's muster book. Every name on it belongs to someone who marched beside you.
hollowed_ledger_page.lore: Corporal Vane  -  Claimed at the Verge. Shield-Brother Garrick  -  Bound to the Gate. Pyromancer Solen  -  Consumed at the Shrine. Commander Kaelen  -  Hollowed at the Great Tree. At the very bottom, written in fresh ink, is your name - followed by the words: 'Vessel in progress.'

corruption_variants.low: The ink beside your name is faint and smudged - your fate is not yet sealed.
corruption_variants.mid: The letters of your name glow like dying embers on the parchment.
corruption_variants.high: The words 'Vessel in progress' shift before your eyes to read: 'Almost Home.'

candoras_tear.title: Candora's Silver Tear
candoras_tear.name: Candora's Silver Tear
candoras_tear.subtitle: Solen's Last Prayer
candoras_tear.memory_text: A warm moonstone clutched in Pyromancer Solen's burned hand - the last ember of grace he protected from the dark.
candoras_tear.lore: Even as Andras twisted Solen's sacred hearth-fire into a storm of madness, Solen hid this crystallised tear of Candora beneath his robes for you. It hums with a quiet, stubborn warmth that pushes back the demon's hold on your heart.

corruption_variants.low: Pure silver light washes through your chest, steadying your human heartbeat.
corruption_variants.mid: The tear sears against your darkened palm, burning away a layer of Andras's ash.
corruption_variants.high: Even through the thick void around your soul, Solen's final gift refuses to go dark.

amalgam_core.title: Kaelen's Broken Medallion
amalgam_core.name: Kaelen's Broken Medallion
amalgam_core.subtitle: The Mentor's Burden
amalgam_core.memory_text: Commander Kaelen's Star-Fire medallion, split in two the night he marched ahead alone to challenge Andras.
amalgam_core.lore: Kaelen knew the pact was a trap. He took the heaviest share of the curse upon himself and walked into the heart of the Bleeding Tree hoping to slay the Marquis from within. Even hollowed into the Dark Ronin, he waited at the threshold for the one student he believed could finish what he started.

corruption_variants.low: The medallion's fractured halves click together - Kaelen's pride in you outlasted the demon.
corruption_variants.mid: Shadow and starlight twine around the metal, echoing your mentor's final warning.
corruption_variants.high: The core throbs with Kaelen's sorrow: in defeating him with demonic fury, you have taken his place.

bark_of_the_great_one.title: Bark of the Weeping Heartwood
bark_of_the_great_one.name: Bark of the Weeping Heartwood
bark_of_the_great_one.subtitle: Corporal Vane's Tally
bark_of_the_great_one.memory_text: A shard of crimson-sap bark clutched in Corporal Vane's claws, scored with seven hash-marks for the days he waited for rescue.
bark_of_the_great_one.lore: Before his mind broke completely, Vane carved his sister's name and the Watch's distress cipher into this living bark. The tree drank his grief and gave him monstrous endurance in return.

corruption_variants.low: You trace the carved letters gently, vowing to carry Vane's memory out of the woods.
corruption_variants.mid: Crimson sap seeps from the grooves, pulsing against your scarred palm.
corruption_variants.high: The bark fuses to your gauntlet, feeding your strikes with Vane's dying rage.

the_eye.title: The Eye of Andras
the_eye.name: The Eye of Andras
the_eye.subtitle: Ocular Prism of the Fallen
the_eye.memory_text: An ancient prism torn from Vane's chest. It slows demon time and reveals the ghostly echoes of every comrade who fell before you.
the_eye.lore: Forged by Andras to watch his vessels struggle, yet bound to the memories of your fallen squad. Press [V] when its resonance is full to fracture time itself - seeing the forest as the spirit realm sees it.

corruption_variants.low: Through the lens, you see the silver footprints of your comrades guiding you forward.
corruption_variants.mid: The pupil dilates on its own, whispering where the next vessel waits.
corruption_variants.high: You and the Eye share a single pulse; time bends to your hunger.

pre_fight: Hold... state your company and cipher! Wait - I know that blade stance...
Andras couldn't force me to unlock the Obsidian Ward, so he welded my armor across it! Strike true, brother - break this prison and keep the Rift sealed!
GreenMonster.death_line: My oath... passes to you, kid. Keep the 10,000-soul tithe out of his hands... free Kaelen...

corruption_variants.low: Your steel still shines with Watch silver. Thank the stars... he hasn't turned your oath into his key.
corruption_variants.mid: Wait - the Marquis's brand is glowing on your palm! Stop feeding his scythe before he uses you to crack the gate!
corruption_variants.high: No... you reek of the 10,000-soul tithe. He didn't send you to rescue us - he sent you to unlock his cage!

combat_taunts: Keep your shield up! My claws don't obey me anymore!
Shatter this cursed armor, Watchman - before the Gate fractures!
A Guardian never yields a ward!

pre_fight: Hold... state your company and cipher! Wait - I know that blade stance...
Andras offered to heal my crushed ribs if I opened the Watch's second seal. When I refused, he fused me to the stone arch. End this watch for me, brother!
Gatekeeper.death_line: The iron chain... snaps at last. Reach Solen before Andras takes the flame... keep the Citadel safe...

corruption_variants.low: You still fight like one of Kaelen's own! Break this shell while your oath is still yours!
corruption_variants.mid: That brand on your hand is glowing hot. Guard your soul - Solen still carries Candora's Silver Tear ahead!
corruption_variants.high: Why do your eyes burn with the Marquis's fire?! Did you really strike a deal with our jailer?!

combat_taunts: Keep your guard raised! I cannot hold back my own strikes!
Is that the footing Commander Kaelen taught you?!
Break this stone shell, brother - do not let him break the Citadel's gate!
Gatekeeper.primary: I refused to open the Citadel's seal - so Andras welded me to the stone.

pre_fight: Hold... state your company and cipher! Wait - I know that blade stance...
Andras offered to heal my crushed ribs if I opened the Watch's second seal. When I refused, he fused me to the stone arch. End this watch for me, brother!
Garrick, The Iron Bulwark.death_line: The iron chain... snaps at last. Reach Solen before Andras takes the flame... keep the Citadel safe...

corruption_variants.mid: That brand on your hand is glowing hot. Guard your soul - Solen still carries Candora's Silver Tear ahead!
corruption_variants.high: Why do your eyes burn with the Marquis's fire?! Did you really strike a deal with our jailer?!

Break this stone shell, brother - do not let him break the Citadel's gate!
Garrick, The Iron Bulwark.primary: I refused to open the Citadel's seal - so Andras welded me to the stone.

pre_fight: Wait... that cloak... you're from the Fourth Vanguard! You actually woke up?!
Andras promised me the sap would buy time until Kaelen reinforced the Seal... When I refused to hand over the Watch cipher, he twisted my blood into starvation!
End me before he forces my claws through another brother!
BloodZombie.death_line: Free at last... Take my prism, kid - use it to see through the forest's lies, NOT to feed his cage...

corruption_variants.low: Your eyes are still clear... Cut me loose while the Watcher's oath is still clean in your chest.
corruption_variants.mid: You carry his sigil too! Listen to me - every soul his scythe reaps weakens the Great Tree's seal!
corruption_variants.high: No... you drank deep from his power already. He is turning you into the key that sets him free!

combat_taunts: Run! My claws are starving for Watch blood - I can't stop them!
Why does he want a Watchman's hand on the final gate?!
The sap burns! Cut it out of me, brother!
BloodZombie.primary: Wait... that cloak... End me before Andras turns my hunger on the Citadel!

End me before he forces my claws through another brother!
Corporal Vane, The Weeping Husk.death_line: Free at last... Take my prism, kid - use it to see through the forest's lies, NOT to feed his cage...

corruption_variants.mid: You carry his sigil too! Listen to me - every soul his scythe reaps weakens the Great Tree's seal!
corruption_variants.high: No... you drank deep from his power already. He is turning you into the key that sets him free!

Why does he want a Watchman's hand on the final gate?!
The sap burns! Cut it out of me, brother!
Corporal Vane, The Weeping Husk.primary: Wait... that cloak... End me before Andras turns my hunger on the Citadel!

pre_fight: Stay back from the shrine! Andras hijacked my hearth-fire to melt the Silver Roots sealing his tomb!
Even with my mind burning, I locked half his power inside Candora's Tear beneath my robes.
Cut me down and claim that Tear - burn his Harvester key off your hand before you meet Kaelen!
FireWizard.death_line: The wildfire dies... Wash the Marquis's brand clean with Candora's Tear... collapse the Rift for good!

corruption_variants.low: You kept your heart clean of his hunger. Take Candora's Tear - it will steel you for Kaelen's final seal!
corruption_variants.mid: Your scythe drips with stolen souls. Let Candora's Tear burn Andras's claim out of your veins before it's too late!
corruption_variants.high: That black flame around you... Andras didn't send you to save us. You're carrying his unlocking tithe straight to Kaelen!

combat_taunts: A Pyromancer's flame will not fuel a demon's prison break!
Endure the fire, Guardian - claim Candora's Tear!
Quench my wildfire with your steel!
FireWizard.primary: Take Candora's Tear from my robes and burn Andras's key off your hand!

Even with my mind burning, I locked half his power inside Candora's Tear beneath my robes.
Cut me down and claim that Tear - burn his Harvester key off your hand before you meet Kaelen!
Pyromancer Solen, The Ash Keeper.death_line: The wildfire dies... Wash the Marquis's brand clean with Candora's Tear... collapse the Rift for good!

corruption_variants.low: You kept your heart clean of his hunger. Take Candora's Tear - it will steel you for Kaelen's final seal!
corruption_variants.mid: Your scythe drips with stolen souls. Let Candora's Tear burn Andras's claim out of your veins before it's too late!
corruption_variants.high: That black flame around you... Andras didn't send you to save us. You're carrying his unlocking tithe straight to Kaelen!

Endure the fire, Guardian - claim Candora's Tear!
Quench my wildfire with your steel!
Pyromancer Solen, The Ash Keeper.primary: Take Candora's Tear from my robes and burn Andras's key off your hand!

pre_fight: So... you reached the Rift-Gate beneath the Bleeding Tree, recruit.

I couldn't slay an immortal Marquis through bars of Watch stone - so I drove my own oath straight through the gate to lock him below until one of ours arrived strong enough to shatter the roots onto his head.
Show me why you fought your way here! Did you come to bury Andras's prison forever... or break it open for him?!
DarkRonin.death_line: That final parry... pure Watch steel. Strike the roots now - seal the Marquis in the dark forever...

corruption_variants.low: You gathered your brothers' oaths and burned off the Marquis's brand. Together we seal this gate once and for all!
corruption_variants.mid: Your palm still smolders with his Harvest mark. Strike with everything I taught you - or the wrong side of this gate falls!
corruption_variants.high: Ten thousand souls screaming in your scythe... Andras fooled you cleanly, student. Only one blade leaves this tree - draw!

combat_taunts: A Guardian strikes to protect the living, never to feed a demon's cage!
Every strike tests who holds your oath!
Show me what the Fourth Vanguard died protecting!
DarkRonin.primary: Did you march here to bury Andras's Rift forever... or unlock it for him?!

pre_fight: So... you reached the Rift-Gate beneath the Bleeding Tree, recruit.

I couldn't slay an immortal Marquis through bars of Watch stone - so I drove my own oath straight through the gate to lock him below until one of ours arrived strong enough to shatter the roots onto his head.
Show me why you fought your way here! Did you come to bury Andras's prison forever... or break it open for him?!
Commander Kaelen, The Hollowed Mentor.death_line: That final parry... pure Watch steel. Strike the roots now - seal the Marquis in the dark forever...

corruption_variants.low: You gathered your brothers' oaths and burned off the Marquis's brand. Together we seal this gate once and for all!
corruption_variants.mid: Your palm still smolders with his Harvest mark. Strike with everything I taught you - or the wrong side of this gate falls!
corruption_variants.high: Ten thousand souls screaming in your scythe... Andras fooled you cleanly, student. Only one blade leaves this tree - draw!

Every strike tests who holds your oath!
Show me what the Fourth Vanguard died protecting!
Commander Kaelen, The Hollowed Mentor.primary: Did you march here to bury Andras's Rift forever... or unlock it for him?!

evil_eye.name: Andras (Marquis of Discord)
barks: Your comrades begged for mercy too, runner. Only my shadow kept you breathing!
Drink deep of the rift! Why die a mortal soldier when you can reign as my vessel?
Every strike brings you closer to Kaelen's throne of ash. Do not hold back!

moon_knight.name: The Moon Knight (Candora's Envoy)
barks: Remember the Star-Fire Watch, Guardian! Those you face were once your brothers-in-arms.
Stay human, runner. Candora's silver light still reaches into these ruined shrines.
Grant your fallen company peace with a clean blade - do not let Andras hollow your heart.

on_kill.text: Yes. Feel that surge? That is not grief - that is the strength your squad lacked.
Another hollow bone returned to the mud. You are outgrowing your mortal vows.
Kaelen fought just like that before he kneeled. Keep swinging, my vessel.
They were already dead when we found them. You are merely clearing the road.

on_relic.text: Good - claim another Captain's oath-relic. Every ward you tear down brings my Rift-Gate closer to opening.
Another threshold cleared. Feed the 10,000-soul tithe, Harvester - my chains are groaning.
You think you are freeing them? Every oath you pry from their hands unlocks another bar of my prison.

on_near_death.text: Do not die in the dirt now, Harvester! Channel the sigil on your hand - only a Star-Fire oath can break Kaelen's gate!

on_boss_spawn.text: Another stubborn officer guarding the Rift-Gate. Cut him out of my way, Harvester - ten thousand souls await.

on_threshold_crossed.text: One third of the Watch seal has turned into my key. Keep reaping.
Half the tithe is paid. The human Citadel behind these trees will never know you swung the axe.
Two thirds mine. Your mortal vow belongs to the Rift now.
The Harvester's Key is forged! Now shatter Kaelen's final seal and let me out!

on_kill.text: May the stars receive their restless bones. Keep your heart steady, Guardian.
Strike only to survive and free the fallen - never for the joy of the slaughter.
The silver light in your eyes grows dimmer with each furious swing. Breathe, runner.
Guardian, please - do not lose yourself to the bloodlust that took your squad!

on_relic.text: Hold your comrade's keepsake close. Remembering who they were is how you stay human.
Candora's grace lingers in the love you bear for your fallen company.
Let their memory anchor you. They gave their lives so you could walk free, not enslaved.

on_near_death.text: Stand fast, Guardian! Rely on the training Kaelen gave you, not the demon's poison!
Candora's moonlight shields the steadfast. Hold the line!

on_boss_spawn.text: Look beneath the curse - that warrior once stood beside you at the watchfire.
Grant your fallen comrade a clean release, and carry their memory toward the dawn.

on_threshold_crossed.text: The sigil on your palm is spreading. Seek the Moon-Shrines and Solen's tear to cleanse it!
You stand at the precipice where Garrick and Vane lost their names. Turn back toward the light!
Even through the gathering void, I still hear your human heart beating. Do not surrender!
Kaelen awaits ahead... only a miracle of remembrance can save you now.

dark.title: THE BROKEN SEAL
lines: Commander Kaelen falls against the Bleeding Tree as the 10,000-soul scythe plunges into the earth.
With your Watch oath hollowed by Discord, the four thresholds shatter from the Citadel's own side.
Andras steps free through the torn Rift-Gate wearing your shadow - while you take Kaelen's charred chains in the pit below.
On the horizon beyond the Elderwood, the warning bells of the human Citadel begin to ring.
dark.andras_outro: At last! The Fourth Vanguard locked my cage for a decade - and you just handed me the key.

light.title: THE SEAL RESTORED
lines: As Kaelen's blade comes to rest, Candora's Silver Tear blazes against the Harvester brand on your palm.
Purged of Discord, the four Star-Fire Oaths of Vane, Garrick, Solen, and Kaelen fuse into your steel - sealing the Rift from within.
Beneath the collapsing roots, Andras's bellowing roar is cut off forever as silver dawn pours through the canopy.
The Citadel behind the woods sleeps in safety. You walk out carrying your fallen brothers' medallions home.
light.moon_knight_outro: You bore their oaths without yielding your soul, Guardian - and buried the Marquis beneath his own snare.

ambiguous.title: THE SCARRED GATEKEEPER
lines: Commander Kaelen breathes his last as the Rift-Gate slams shut - scarred, yet unbroken.
Andras remains trapped beneath the Bleeding Tree, though his Harvester brand still smolders faintly on your gauntlet.
You cannot return to the Citadel while the Marquis's mark lingers in your blood, nor will you yield him the key.
Drawing Kaelen's blade into the earth beside your own, you take the eternal watch at the Gate.
ambiguous.andras_outro: So close, Watchman... Stand your vigil at my door. One slip of your heart, and the gate opens.

skeleton_minion.primary: Risen bones of forgotten vanguards rattle from the roots to bar your march!
combat_taunts: Join our silent regiment in the mud!
The Marquis commands the fallen - surrender your flesh!
No Watchman leaves the Elderwood whole!

corruption_variants.low: Your Watch steel still cuts with mortal resolve.
corruption_variants.mid: You strike with the fury of one half-claimed by the rift.
corruption_variants.high: Why cut us down, brother, when we serve the same master?

node_03_void_scribe.primary: I am Scribe Orin of the Fourth Vanguard. Even in death, I keep the muster roll of those Andras hollowed.
node_03_void_scribe.death_line: Keep the roll safe... do not let the Citadel forget our names...
node_03_void_scribe.corruption_low: Your name is still unstained on my parchment, Guardian. Keep your blade clean.
node_03_void_scribe.corruption_mid: Soot is gathering around your entry in the ledger. Remember why we marched here.
node_03_void_scribe.corruption_high: The Marquis is already dictating your final title across the bottom of the page.

relic_branch.text: You carry the torn muster roll. Read Vane and Garrick's names aloud when the dark presses in.

node_04_void_bloom.primary: A Moon-Lily blooms beside a fallen Watchman's helm - silver petals drinking the ash to keep a single spark of light alive.
node_04_void_bloom.corruption_low: The silver petals chime softly, recognizing a Guardian who still honors his oath.
node_04_void_bloom.corruption_mid: The flower trembles between silver grace and crimson rot as your shadow passes.
node_04_void_bloom.corruption_high: The petals curl into black cinders at the heat of your demonic brand.

node_06_candora_messenger.primary: I am Candora's Envoy. Pyromancer Solen prayed with his last human breath that I would intercept you before the shrine.
combat_taunts: Hold onto your honor, Guardian!
Every time you unleash Andras's flame, your comrades' sacrifice fades.
node_06_candora_messenger.death_line: Though my wings fade, Candora's moonlight still guides your blade...
node_06_candora_messenger.corruption_low: Solen would weep with relief to see your spirit still unbowed.
node_06_candora_messenger.corruption_mid: The rift's venom is in your veins, yet Solen hid a Tear of Candora ahead to cleanse you.
node_06_candora_messenger.corruption_high: You are nearly lost to the Marquis - seek Solen's Tear at once, or Kaelen is doomed!

relic_branch.text: You hold Solen's last gift. Let Candora's Tear cool the brand on your hand before you face Kaelen.

node_07_mural.primary: An ancient Watch memorial stone carved by Commander Kaelen's own blade: 'Here the Fourth Vanguard stood against the night.'
node_07_mural.corruption_low: Running your fingers over Kaelen's carving fills your chest with quiet resolve.
node_07_mural.corruption_mid: Claw marks have gouged through the vows, leaving only Kaelen's warning beneath.
node_07_mural.corruption_high: Through your void-touched gaze, the memorial looks like an altar awaiting your sacrifice.

node_08_previous_runner.primary: I was Kaelen's second-in-command before the Bleeding Tree drank my voice. He waits just ahead at the final threshold.
combat_taunts: Guard your flank, recruit!
Power without remembrance is just another chain!
node_08_previous_runner.death_line: Free the Commander... he held out longer than any of us...
node_08_previous_runner.corruption_low: You carry the Watch's light just as Kaelen hoped. Go - give our Commander peace.
node_08_previous_runner.corruption_mid: This is the very mile where I gave in to the sigil. Do not repeat my mistake at the threshold.
node_08_previous_runner.corruption_high: If you strike Kaelen down with that much darkness in your heart, you will simply become the new Dark Ronin.

relic_branch.text: You have seen the broken medallion. Then you know Kaelen took the curse to shield you.

node_10_void_silence.primary: As the Bleeding Great Tree towers overhead, the forest falls dead silent. For three heartbeats, you hear the watchfire laughter of your lost company.
node_10_void_silence.corruption_low: Their voices steady your grip: you are fighting to set them free.
node_10_void_silence.corruption_mid: Beneath their laughter, Andras's low whisper urges you to claim the tree.
node_10_void_silence.corruption_high: The memory of their laughter burns like salt; only the pulse of the Great Tree feels real.
